title: Mapua Malayan Colleges Laguna suspends on-site classes over security concern
summary: Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna suspended on-site classes effective Thursday as a precaution following a reported security concern.

blocks.text: Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna suspended on-site classes effective Thursday as a precaution following a reported security concern.
In an advisory, the school said students who were scheduled to attend classes on campus will shift to synchronous online learning.
“School administration is working closely with local law enforcement and emergency personnel, who are currently conducting a thorough investigation,” Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna said.
No further details were provided by the school.—Joviland Rita/OL, GMA News
